name: card
title: Card
description: A bordered surface that groups related content: a KPI, a form section, a record summary. Not a page, not a modal.
docs: Ejected from @macaw-ds/ui@0.0.0. Use the sections (Header, Body, Footer) rather than custom padding; the Card owns its spacing. Card.Title sets the heading level with `as` to fit the page outline.

manifest.name: Card
manifest.purpose: A bordered surface that groups related content: a KPI, a form section, a record summary. Not a page, not a modal.
manifest.description: A compound component. `Card` is the surface; `Card.Header`, `Card.Title`, `Card.Description`, `Card.Body` and `Card.Footer` lay out its parts with the padding the Card sets. Structure comes from a 1 px border; elevation is optional and subtle. `interactive` with `asChild` turns the whole card into a link or button with the shared focus ring.

padding.description: Inner padding for the sections. none when the body is a table or an image that should touch the edges.

elevation.description: flat relies on the border; raised adds a subtle shadow for cards that float over the canvas.

interactive.description: Hover border and the focus ring. Use with asChild so the card is an anchor or a button.
interactive.a11y: An interactive card must be an anchor or a button (asChild) so it has a role and keyboard activation.

asChild.description: Render the child element as the card.

children.description: Card.Header, Card.Body, Card.Footer in that order.

a11y.role: none for a static card; link or button when interactive with asChild
keyboard: Interactive cards (asChild anchor or button): Tab to focus, Enter (and Space for buttons) to activate
a11y.name: Static cards have none. Interactive cards take the name from their text content; keep the title first so it is read first.
notes: Card.Title renders an h3 by default. Set `as` to keep heading levels in order on the page.
Do not nest interactive elements inside an interactive card; a card that is a link cannot contain buttons.
The footer's sunken background keeps 4.5:1 for primary and secondary text.

rules: Use the sections (Header, Body, Footer) rather than custom padding; the Card owns its spacing.
Card.Title sets the heading level with `as` to fit the page outline.
Interactive cards use asChild with an anchor or a button and contain no other interactive elements.
One primary action per card footer at most.
dos: Use padding="none" and put a table in Card.Body so rows run edge to edge.
Use Card.Description for a one-line summary under the title.
donts: Do not use elevation to signal importance; use position and heading level.

examples.name: Interactive
examples.description: The whole card is a link.
